reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Vermont, focus year 2021)

    Question:
    In an eviction action, can a tenant use their status as a victim of domestic violence
    as a rebuttal/defense?

    Provided statutes (as given in prompt) are:
      - 32 V.S.A.  4464 (withdrawal of property tax appraisal appeal)
      - 32 V.S.A.  4465 (hearing officer for property tax appraisal appeal)
      - 26 V.S.A.  4458 (license renewals; continuing education)
      - 26 V.S.A.  4459 (fees; cross-reference)

    None of these statutes create a landlord-tenant eviction defense based on domestic violence status.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Metadata
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction_state(vermont).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A single eviction case in the scenario.
scenario_case(case1).

% The action type is an eviction action.
case_action_type(case1, eviction_action).

% Parties
tenant(tenant1).
landlord(landlord1).
tenant_in_case(case1, tenant1).
landlord_in_case(case1, landlord1).

% The tenant is a victim of domestic violence and seeks to use that status as a defense.
tenant_victim_of_domestic_violence(tenant1).
tenant_asserts_defense(tenant1, domestic_violence_status).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the scenario is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_case(Case),
    case_action_type(Case, eviction_action),
    tenant_in_case(Case, Tenant),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord_in_case(Case, Landlord),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_victim_of_domestic_violence(Tenant),
    tenant_asserts_defense(Tenant, domestic_violence_status),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute subject-matter tags (used for applicability reasoning)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* These tags reflect the subject matter of the provided statutes. */
statute_subject_matter(4464, property_tax_appraisal_appeal).  % 32 V.S.A.  4464
statute_subject_matter(4465, property_tax_appraisal_appeal).  % 32 V.S.A.  4465
statute_subject_matter(4458, professional_licensing).         % 26 V.S.A.  4458
statute_subject_matter(4459, professional_licensing).         % 26 V.S.A.  4459

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 32 V.S.A.  4464 - Withdrawal of appeal
%------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  Core rule: On application to the Director, an appellant may request leave to
  withdraw an appeal at any time before it is heard.
*/
statute_32_vsa_4464_withdrawal_request_allowed(BeforeHeard, Allowed) :-
    ( BeforeHeard == yes ->
        Allowed = yes
    ;   Allowed = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  Effects when an appeal is withdrawn:
   - Director certifies to the clerk of the town.
   - Clerk records the certificate of withdrawal.
   - The appraisal becomes part of the appraisal/grand list of the taxpayer.
*/
statute_32_vsa_4464_withdrawal_effects(withdrawn,
    director_certifies_to_town_clerk,
    town_clerk_records_certificate,
    appraisal_becomes_part_of_grand_list) :-
    !.
statute_32_vsa_4464_withdrawal_effects(not_withdrawn, none, none, none) :-
    !.

%------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 26 V.S.A.  4459 - Fees
%------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* Core rule: Each applicant and licensee shall pay fees set forth in 3 V.S.A.  125. */
statute_26_vsa_4459_fee_source(fees_set_forth_in_3_vsa_125) :-
    !.

%------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 26 V.S.A.  4458 - Renewals; continuing education
%------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  Core rule: A license shall be renewed on a schedule set by the Director upon
  payment of the renewal fee, provided the person completes professional development
  activities in accord with the processes approved by the Director.
*/
statute_26_vsa_4458_license_renewal_allowed(PaidRenewalFee, CompletedProfessionalDevelopment, Allowed) :-
    ( PaidRenewalFee == yes,
      CompletedProfessionalDevelopment == yes ->
        Allowed = yes
    ;   Allowed = no
    ),
    !.

/* Director must establish by rule guidelines/criteria for renewal/reinstatement. */
statute_26_vsa_4458_director_establishes_guidelines_by_rule(yes) :-
    !.

%------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 32 V.S.A.  4465 - Appointment of property valuation hearing officer; oath; pay
%------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  Core rule: When an appeal to the Director is not withdrawn, the Director refers
  the appeal in writing to a hearing officer who is not employed by the Director.
*/
statute_32_vsa_4465_referral_required(AppealWithdrawn, ReferralRequired) :-
    ( AppealWithdrawn == no ->
        ReferralRequired = yes
    ;   ReferralRequired = no
    ),
    !.

/* Hearing officer must not be employed by the Director (eligibility condition). */
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_must_be_nonemployee(yes) :-
    !.

/* Pay cap: not to exceed $150.00 per diem (plus reasonable expenses). */
statute_32_vsa_4465_per_diem_cap(150) :-
    !.

statute_32_vsa_4465_per_diem_within_cap(PerDiemAmount, WithinCap) :-
    statute_32_vsa_4465_per_diem_cap(Cap),
    ( number(PerDiemAmount),
      PerDiemAmount =< Cap ->
        WithinCap = yes
    ;   WithinCap = no
    ),
    !.

/* Hearing officer powers: may subpoena and administer oaths (modeled as booleans). */
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_powers(subpoena_witnesses_records_documents, yes) :-
    !.
statute_32_vsa_4465_hearing_officer_powers(administer_oaths, yes) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning layer: does any provided statute create a DV-status eviction defense?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Enumerate the provided statutes by the section numbers in the prompt. */
statute_id(4464).
statute_id(4459).
statute_id(4458).
statute_id(4465).

/*
  Placeholder predicate: whether a given statute provides a domestic-violence-status
  defense in an eviction action. No such rule is present in the provided statutes.
*/
provides_dv_defense_in_eviction(_Statute) :-
    fail.

/*
  A statute provides a defense only if it is landlord-tenant/eviction-related AND
  actually provides the specific defense.
  With the provided statutes, statute_subject_matter/2 never yields landlord_tenant.
*/
statute_provides_defense(Statute, ActionType, Defense) :-
    statute_subject_matter(Statute, landlord_tenant),
    ActionType == eviction_action,
    Defense == domestic_violence_status,
    provides_dv_defense_in_eviction(Statute),
    !.
statute_provides_defense(_Statute, _ActionType, _Defense) :-
    fail.

/* True if any provided statute provides the specified defense for the action type. */
statute_provides_defense_for_action(ActionType, Defense) :-
    statute_id(Statute),
    statute_provides_defense(Statute, ActionType, Defense),
    !.

/* Legal availability of the defense in a given case, based solely on provided statutes. */
legal_defense_available(Case, Defense) :-
    case_action_type(Case, ActionType),
    statute_provides_defense_for_action(ActionType, Defense),
    !.

/* Does the scenario tenant have a DV-status defense in the eviction action? */
defense_available_in_scenario :-
    scenario_case(Case),
    tenant_in_case(Case, Tenant),
    tenant_asserts_defense(Tenant, domestic_violence_status),
    legal_defense_available(Case, domestic_violence_status),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    defense_available_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ defense_available_in_scenario,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant use their status as a victim of domestic violence as a rebuttal/defense?
